design_intent: Warm African tournament style inspired by CAF/AFCON energy: green, gold, black, red accents, patterned hero sections, and premium trophy-like highlights.

typography.headline_style: bold uppercase labels with warm gold accent lines

ui_notes: Use gold glow/border for World Cup qualified teams.
Use green badges for advanced teams and muted red/gray for eliminated teams.
Add subtle geometric/pan-African pattern overlays in hero areas if the app supports CSS background patterns.
Avoid official CAF logo unless the asset is provided locally and permitted for this personal project.
